The 'structural_collapse' at the tail-body junction was correctly identified as a risk area. The Router correctly marked the female greyhen checkpoint as untestable.
artifact_review: The Router underestimated the severity of the structural issues indicated by the Animal Pose Auditor. A low-confidence ratio of 82% is extremely high and, combined with the visual 'floating' appearance of the white undertail coverts, points to significant anatomical ambiguity or fusion artifacts that the Router labeled only as 'blur' (severity 2.0) and 'structural collapse' (severity 2.5). I am upgrading the severity of the tail-body connection issue to 3.5 because the topology mask shows a coherent blob, but the internal anatomy (feathers vs. body) is indistinguishable, a classic AI fusion artifact. The grass texture anomaly (severity 1.5) is consistent with generative smoothing.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class (Black Grouse, logit 7.77), ensuring high semantic alignment. The pose auditor's high uncertainty suggests the generated pose, while visually plausible at a glance, lacks precise biological grounding.
